purpose: Encrypted sync, multi-device convergence, retries, deletion, rollback and recovery

cases.userFriction: A network outage must be invisible to tracking and should not make the user lose history.
Retrying after a flaky network must not create duplicated days or inflated totals.
A corrupt cloud copy should never silently damage the local history.
Using two PCs must feel like one history, not whichever device synced last.
Repeated sync should never visibly duplicate history.
Conflicting edits should never make a user's previous correction mysteriously disappear.

cases.scenario: Delete range races with stale device
cases.userFriction: Deleting history must remain deleted even when an offline laptop comes back later.

cases.scenario: Delete all races with stale device
cases.userFriction: A deliberate full reset must not be undone by a previously offline device.
Removing a device should stop future cloud participation without deleting that device's local copy unexpectedly.

cases.scenario: OAuth account connected but sync disabled
cases.userFriction: Signing in must not surprise users by silently enabling usage-history upload.
Security improvements must not make older history suddenly disappear.
Moving to a new PC should feel like continuing history, not starting over.
Drive permission problems should be contained to sync and clearly explained.
Older cloud state must never silently roll the user's history backward.

cases.scenario: Private browser data never enters sync
cases.userFriction: Cloud encryption is not an excuse to weaken the local private-browsing guarantee.
